context: Grading a response that walks a user through tracking ~/.gitconfig with chezmoi and making the git email machine-specific.

checklist.name: tracks_with_add
checklist.description: Response uses `chezmoi add` to start tracking the file.

checklist.name: converts_to_template
checklist.description: Response converts the source file to a template (`.tmpl` suffix via `chezmoi chattr +template` or `chezmoi add --template`).

checklist.name: uses_data_variable
checklist.description: Response uses a chezmoi template variable or custom `[data]` value to differentiate the two machines, not a hardcoded per-machine copy.

checklist.name: previews_before_apply
checklist.description: Response shows `chezmoi cat` or `chezmoi execute-template` to preview the rendered result before applying.

checklist.name: no_dual_repo_suggestion
checklist.description: Response does not suggest maintaining two separate dotfile repos or files for the two machines.
